description.en: ChoroplethMap-Bench evaluates spatial understanding of foundation models with 2,400 synthetic choropleth maps, corresponding GeoJSON data, and 12,000 questions across five cognitive dimensions (Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, Delineate). Models are assessed under Data Only, Map Only, and Data + Map conditions.

evidence.snippet: We introduce ChoroplethMap-Bench, a controlled benchmark containing 2,400 synthetic choropleth maps, corresponding GeoJSON data, and 12,000 questions across five cognitive dimensions: Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, and Delineate.

claire_radar.motivation: Spatial understanding is crucial for foundation models (FMs), and maps have long helped humans organize and reason about geographic information.

claire_radar.paperTitle: Do Maps Still Matter for Machines: Revisiting the Role of Choropleth Maps in Foundation Model Spatial Understanding

source.title: Do Maps Still Matter for Machines: Revisiting the Role of Choropleth Maps in Foundation Model Spatial Understanding

claire_radar.whyItMatters: The benchmark assesses whether cartographic representations add value over structured geodata for machine spatial reasoning, addressing a gap in evaluating map-based inputs. It supports decisions on when to incorporate visual map data in geospatial AI systems.
